# The Journal of Blacks in Higher Education

> > The Journal of Blacks in Higher Education is a comprehensive news and job platform dedicated to covering African American experiences, achievements, and challenges in higher education, with particular focus on HBCUs and university leadership.

JBHE serves as a primary source for breaking news, research, and professional opportunities in higher education with emphasis on historically Black colleges and universities (HBCUs). The platform combines journalism, research archiving, and recruitment services to support the Black higher education community.

## Key Topics

- HBCUs (Historically Black Colleges and Universities)
- Higher Education
- African American Education
- University Leadership
- Faculty Appointments and Awards
- Black Students
- Breaking News
- HBCU Funding and Philanthropy
- For-Profit Colleges
- Job Board and Recruitment
- Research and Studies
- Racial Disparities in Education
- HBCU News
- Black Studies

## Core Services

- [The Journal of Blacks in Higher Education](https://jbhe.com): Homepage for JBHE, dedicated to African Americans in higher education
- [About JBHE](https://jbhe.com/about): Mission and background of The Journal of Blacks in Higher Education
- [JBHE Jobs](https://jbhe.com/jobs): Job board for faculty and academic positions in higher education
- [Post a Job](https://jbhe.com/hire): Job posting service for higher education employers
- [Partner With Us](https://jbhe.com/partner): Partnership and advertising opportunities with JBHE

## News & Breaking Updates

- [Breaking News Archives](https://jbhe.com/news): Archive of breaking news on higher education and HBCUs
- [Corey Wiggins Named President of Tougaloo College in Mississippi](https://jbhe.com/2026/03/corey-wiggins-named-president-of-tougaloo-college-in-mississippi): News article on Corey Wiggins' appointment as Tougaloo College president
- [Andrew Daire Appointed Provost at North Carolina A&T State University](https://jbhe.com/2026/03/andrew-daire-appointed-provost-at-north-carolina-at-state-university): News article on Andrew Daire's provost appointment at NC A&T
- [Howard University College of Medicine Placed on Accreditation Probation](https://jbhe.com/2026/03/howard-university-college-of-medicine-placed-on-accreditation-probation): News article on Howard University College of Medicine accreditation status

## HBCU Coverage

- [HBCUs Archives](https://jbhe.com/hbcus): Archive of news and updates about historically Black colleges
- [Appointments & Awards Archives](https://jbhe.com/appointments): Archive of faculty appointments and awards in higher education
- [Grants and Gifts Archives](https://jbhe.com/grants-and-gifts): Archive of grants and donations to HBCUs and higher education

## Research & Studies

- [Research & Studies Archives](https://jbhe.com/research-study): Archive of research studies on Black students and HBCUs
- [Report Examines Black Students' Experiences at For-Profit Colleges](https://jbhe.com/2026/03/report-examines-black-students-experiences-at-for-profit-colleges): Research article on Black student outcomes at for-profit colleges
- [Research Shows HBCUs Improve Long-Term Economic Outcomes for Local Black Children](https://jbhe.com/2026/03/research-shows-hbcus-improve-long-term-economic-outcomes-for-local-black-children): Research on HBCU impact on economic mobility in local communities
- [Multi-University Study Examines Experiences of Black Workers in the South](https://jbhe.com/2026/03/multi-university-study-examines-experiences-of-black-workers-in-the-south): Research article on Black workers' experiences and union attitudes

## Academic Disciplines

- [Black Studies Archives](https://jbhe.com/black-studies): Archive of articles on Black studies and faculty in higher education
